_comment: Reusable content angles for the topic engine. /topic-queue expands a client's pillars x these angles into concrete, on-brand topics. `format` is the suggested default (graphic = one idea; carousel = steps/lists/comparisons). {pillar}/{keyword}/{outcome}/{audience} are slots to fill from the client's topics.seed.json.

angles.label: Myth-bust
angles.template: The biggest myth about {pillar} — and the truth
angles.note: Correct a common misbelief. Strong hook, one idea.

angles.label: Mistake list
angles.note: Enumerated pain points; each slide one mistake + fix.

angles.label: Stat / proof
angles.note: One big number + context. Never invent stats — mark [__] if unknown.

angles.label: Case / result
angles.note: Problem -> what we did -> outcome. Use real numbers only if given.

angles.label: Warning / alert
angles.note: Symptom -> cause -> fix. Timely / news-pegged when possible.

angles.label: Trend / now
angles.template: What {trend} means for your {pillar} right now
angles.note: Tie a current shift to the client's world.

angles.label: Explainer
angles.template: What is {term} — and why it matters now
angles.note: Define a concept the audience keeps hearing.

angles.label: Quick win
angles.template: One {pillar} fix you can ship today
